title: context-budget: skill markdown files exceed 300-line threshold
description: The three canonical skill files modified in this run (run.skill.md: 682 lines, spec.skill.md: 566 lines, fix_signal.skill.md: 524 lines) all exceed the 300-line implementation file budget. These files pre-date this run and this run reduced their line counts by 4 lines each. Splitting them to meet the budget requires a dedicated skill-splitting specification.
proposed_resolution: Author a spec to split the canonical skill files at natural section boundaries into included sub-files, or update the context-budget criterion to exempt markdown skill files from the 300-line limit.
